sections.st: Medical Thermoforming Packaging — Cleanroom Class 8, GMP, ISO 9001:2015 · Vapi Gujarat
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures medical thermoforming packaging from our Cleanroom Class 8, GMP-compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom PETG thermoformed trays, blister components, and protective inserts for the complete medical device range. Medical packaging manufacturer from Vapi, Gujarat for orthopedic implant trays, vascular device packaging, ophthalmic packaging, drug delivery device packaging, oncology packaging, respiratory device packaging, wound care packaging, and cardiology device packaging. As a medical thermoforming packaging manufacturer from India, we supply medical-grade packaging components to medical device companies across India and for export.

Medical device packaging is a validated system, not a product. The thermoformed packaging component — the PETG tray or blister shell — must be manufactured under controlled conditions (Cleanroom Class 8), from validated medical-grade materials (PETG, medical-grade HIPS), with dimensional consistency confirmed by documented inspection per production batch. Trizen manufactures the thermoformed packaging component under GMP and ISO 9001:2015. The complete sterile barrier system (tray + Tyvek or foil lid + heat seal) is assembled and validated by the medical device manufacturer.

faqs.q: What medical thermoforming packaging does Trizen manufacture?
faqs.a: Custom PETG thermoformed packaging components for the complete medical device range — orthopedic implant trays, vascular device packaging, ophthalmic packaging, drug delivery device packaging, oncology packaging, respiratory device packaging, wound care packaging, and cardiology device packaging. Produced in Cleanroom Class 8 under GMP and ISO 9001:2015. Medical packaging manufacturer from Vapi, Gujarat.

faqs.q: What certifications does Trizen's medical packaging facility have?
faqs.a: ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management System), GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), Cleanroom Class 8 (ISO 14644-1 — 100,000 particles/m³). All medical packaging production in the Class 8 cleanroom with full GMP batch documentation.

faqs.q: What is face seal blister packaging for medical devices?
faqs.a: A face seal blister tray is a thermoformed PETG component with a flat sealing flange. The medical device is loaded into the cavity by the device manufacturer, and a Tyvek or foil lid is heat-sealed to the flat flange to complete the sterile barrier system. Trizen manufactures the thermoformed PETG tray component — the device loading, lid sealing, and sterilization are performed by the medical device manufacturer.

faqs.q: Is PETG compatible with EO sterilization for medical packaging?
faqs.a: Yes — medical-grade PETG is compatible with Ethylene Oxide (EO) sterilization, which is the primary sterilization method for heat-sensitive medical devices. PETG is also compatible with gamma radiation sterilization. EO compatibility confirmed by material CoA per production batch.

faqs.q: What documentation does Trizen provide for medical packaging supplier qualification?
faqs.a: First article inspection report, dimensional inspection records per production batch, material CoA with medical-grade PETG specification per batch, batch records with full material traceability, ISO 9001:2015 certificate copy, and GMP compliance documentation — all available for medical device manufacturer supplier qualification programmes and ISO 11607 packaging validation documentation package.

faqs.q: Why source medical packaging from Vapi, Gujarat?
faqs.a: Medical packaging manufacturer from Vapi, Gujarat — Cleanroom Class 8, GMP, and ISO 9001:2015 in one facility. Medical packaging manufacturer Gujarat for medical device companies. As a medical thermoforming packaging manufacturer from India, Trizen serves domestic medical device companies and international medical device manufacturers.

faqs.q: What is the blister packaging scope at Trizen for medical devices?
faqs.a: Trizen manufactures the thermoformed PETG tray component and blister shell component only. Device loading into the blister, Tyvek or foil lidding, heat sealing, and sterilization are performed by the medical device manufacturer at their validated facility. This clear scope definition ensures traceability and validation clarity in the medical device manufacturer's DHF.

faqs.q: What is the prototype and production timeline for medical packaging?
faqs.a: First article: 14 to 21 business days from device technical drawing or device sample — cleanroom CNC tooling at Vapi. Production batch: confirmed at brief stage. ISO 9001:2015, GMP, and Cleanroom Class 8 documentation per production batch.
